description: Asks to publish a finished task. An opted-in connection can display a confirmation for the exact revision. Otherwise give the person the signed-in approval link. A 30 second undo window follows approval. Read the existing request with get_approval.

finish_with.description: Return the signed-in approval link without prompting here.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

task_id.description: The task whose change goes live (list_tasks gives ids).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: publish_task
title: Put a change live
